# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## What This Is

Unreal Engine 5.4.4 source code. A C++ game engine with a C#-based build system (UnrealBuildTool). The codebase contains the full engine runtime, editor, plugins, tools, shaders, and content.

## Build Commands

### Initial Setup (run once after cloning)
```
Setup.bat                          # Downloads binary dependencies (~18+ GiB), installs prerequisites, sets up git hooks
GenerateProjectFiles.bat           # Generates UE5.sln and .vcxproj files via UnrealBuildTool
```

### Building
```
# Full editor build (via custom build.bat at repo root)
build.bat

# Build a specific target via UnrealBuildTool directly
Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat <TargetName> <Platform> <Configuration>
# Examples:
Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat UnrealEditor Win64 Development
Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat UnrealGame Win64 Development

# Run UnrealBuildTool directly
Engine\Build\BatchFiles\RunUBT.bat <TargetName> <Platform> <Configuration> [flags]

# Run Unreal Automation Tool (packaging, cooking, deployment, build graphs)
Engine\Build\BatchFiles\RunUAT.bat <command> [args]
```

### Build Configurations
- **Debug** - Unoptimized with debug symbols
- **Development** - Optimized with debug info (standard development)
- **Shipping** - Fully optimized release build
- Append "Editor" for editor targets (e.g., "Development Editor" in Visual Studio)

### Build Tools (C# / .NET 6.0)
```
# Rebuild UnrealBuildTool
dotnet build Engine\Source\Programs\UnrealBuildTool\UnrealBuildTool.csproj -c Development

# Rebuild AutomationTool
Engine\Build\BatchFiles\BuildUAT.bat
```

### Visual Studio
- Solution: `UE5.sln` at repo root
- Set configuration to **Development Editor**, platform to **Win64**
- Set startup project to **UE5**, press F5 to debug
- Requires Visual Studio 2022 (17.4+, 17.8 recommended)

## Architecture

### Source Organization (`Engine/Source/`)

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `Runtime/` | Core engine modules (~177): Core, CoreUObject, Engine, RHI, Renderer, Slate, networking, physics, audio, AI, etc. |
| `Editor/` | Editor modules (~134): UnrealEd, LevelEditor, ContentBrowser, MaterialEditor, Sequencer, BlueprintGraph, etc. |
| `Developer/` | Developer tools (~125): AssetTools, DerivedDataCache, MeshBuilder, ShaderCompiler, profiling, testing, platform support |
| `Programs/` | Standalone tools: UnrealBuildTool, AutomationTool, ShaderCompileWorker, UnrealLightmass, UnrealPak, UnrealInsights |
| `ThirdParty/` | External dependencies |

### Module System

Every engine module has a `ModuleName.Build.cs` file (C#, inherits `ModuleRules`) that declares:
- `PublicDependencyModuleNames` / `PrivateDependencyModuleNames` - module dependencies
- `PublicDefinitions` / `PrivateDefinitions` - preprocessor defines
- `PublicIncludePaths` / `PrivateIncludePaths` - header search paths
- `DynamicallyLoadedModuleNames` - runtime-loaded optional modules
- Platform-conditional logic via `Target.Platform` checks

### Target System

Build targets are defined in `*.Target.cs` files (C#, inherits `TargetRules`) at `Engine/Source/`:
- `UnrealEditor.Target.cs` - Editor (Type: Editor)
- `UnrealGame.Target.cs` - Game client (Type: Game)
- `UnrealServer.Target.cs` - Dedicated server (Type: Server)
- `UnrealClient.Target.cs` - Client (Type: Client)

Game projects define their own `.Target.cs` files following the same pattern.

### Key Runtime Module Dependency Chain

`Core` -> `CoreUObject` -> `Engine` is the fundamental dependency chain. Nearly all modules depend on `Core`. The `Engine` module depends on 100+ other modules including `RHI`, `Slate`, `Messaging`, `AssetRegistry`, etc.

### Reflection and Code Generation (UHT)

Unreal Header Tool (integrated into UBT as `EpicGames.UHT`) processes C++ headers with these macros:
- `UCLASS()`, `USTRUCT()`, `UENUM()` - type declarations for reflection
- `UPROPERTY()` - reflected/serialized properties
- `UFUNCTION()` - reflected/callable functions
- `GENERATED_BODY()` - required in reflected type bodies

These generate `.generated.h` files in the `Intermediate/` directory. The `cpp.hint` file at repo root provides IntelliSense hints for these macros.

### Other Key Directories

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `Engine/Plugins/` | ~58 plugin categories (Animation, AI, FX, PCG, VirtualProduction, Media, Online, etc.) |
| `Engine/Shaders/` | HLSL shader code (`Private/`, `Public/`, `Shared/` subdirs) |
| `Engine/Config/` | INI-based configuration (`Base*.ini` files, platform-specific overrides in subdirs) |
| `Engine/Content/` | Engine assets, materials, meshes, starter content, templates |
| `Engine/Platforms/` | Platform-specific extensions (code, configs, shaders) |
| `Engine/Binaries/` | Compiled binaries and prebuilt tools |
| `Engine/Build/BatchFiles/` | Build scripts for Windows/Mac/Linux |

### Configuration System

Hierarchical INI files with section-based organization:
- `Engine/Config/Base*.ini` - Engine defaults
- Platform overrides in `Engine/Config/<Platform>/`
- Project overrides in `<Project>/Config/`
- Sections use path-like names: `[/Script/Engine.RendererSettings]`
- Array append with `+Key=Value` syntax

### Coding Conventions

- Follow [Epic C++ Coding Standard](https://docs.unrealengine.com/epic-cplusplus-coding-standard-for-unreal-engine/)
- Type prefixes: `F` (structs/plain classes), `U` (UObject-derived), `A` (AActor-derived), `E` (enums), `I` (interfaces), `T` (templates)
- Module API macros for DLL export: `CORE_API`, `ENGINE_API`, `COREUOBJECT_API`, `UNREALED_API`, etc.
- `PRAGMA_DISABLE_*` / `PRAGMA_ENABLE_*` macros for portable warning suppression
- `THIRD_PARTY_INCLUDES_START` / `THIRD_PARTY_INCLUDES_END` to wrap external headers

# `r.MipMapLODBias` 影响 RVT 的路径

对 VT/RVT 来说,这个 CVar **不走 sampler state**(普通纹理才走)。VT 的物理纹理 sampler 显式把 mip bias 填 0,见 [Texture2D.cpp:1546](Source/Runtime/Engine/Private/Texture2D.cpp#L1546) 的注释 "VT currently ignores global mip bias"。它走的是另一条链:

1. [Texture2D.cpp:1438](Source/Runtime/Engine/Private/Texture2D.cpp#L1438) `UTexture2D::GetGlobalMipMapLODBias()` 读取 CVar,clamp 到 ±15
2. [VirtualTextureSystem.cpp:2904](Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/VT/VirtualTextureSystem.cpp#L2904):
   ```cpp
   GetGlobalMipBias() = GetGlobalMipMapLODBias() + MaxResidencyMipMapBias
   ```
   注意第二项:**取所有物理池中 ResidencyMipMapBias 的最大值**
3. [SceneRendering.cpp:2157](Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/SceneRendering.cpp#L2157) 写进 `View.GlobalVirtualTextureMipBias`
4. Shader 里 [VirtualTextureCommon.ush:274](../Shaders/Private/VirtualTextureCommon.ush#L274) 把它加进 vLevel 计算:
   ```hlsl
   MipLevelFromDerivatives = ComputedLevel + Noise + GetGlobalVirtualTextureMipBias();
   ```
   这个 vLevel 同时决定 **page table 查哪一级页** 和 **feedback 请求哪一级页**。RVT 的固定级采样路径(ush 531~592 行)更是直接拿它当起始 vLevel。

所以对 RVT,bias 改变的是"取哪一级 tile",每 +1 级,tile 覆盖面积×4、分辨率减半——直接就是模糊。

# 相机不动却"逐渐"变模糊的原因

这就是 **Residency MipMap Bias 在逐帧爬升**,不是你的材质或源纹理问题:

[VirtualTexturePhysicalSpace.cpp:216](Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/VT/VirtualTexturePhysicalSpace.cpp#L216) `UpdateResidencyTracking()`:
- 可见页占比 > `r.VT.Residency.UpperBound`(0.95)时,每帧 `bias += 0.2 × 超出量`
- 一直累加到 `r.VT.Residency.MaxMipMapBias`(默认 **4**)
- 占比 < LowerBound 才会衰减回去

物理池超订 → bias 以 0.2/帧的速率渐进上涨 → 画面**逐渐**糊掉,最多糊 4 级。这完全吻合你的现象。

而且因为 `GetGlobalMipBias()` 取的是**所有池的 max**,哪怕超订的不是 RVT 自己的池(比如 SVT streaming 池、或另一个 format group 的池),RVT 也会跟着一起糊。

**为什么负的 `r.MipMapLODBias` 能保持清晰**:它和 residency bias 在同一个求和式里,负值直接抵消掉爬升的那部分(residency 上限 4,你给 -4 以下基本就压死了)。但这是掩盖症状——需求页数反而更多,池的压力更大。

# 你的 mip=1 测试说明了什么

把 RVT 采样固定到 mip 1 出现同样的模糊,正好验证了机制:模糊来源就是 **vLevel 选高了一级、拿到的是低分辨率 tile**,和源 color texture 自身的 mip 链无关。residency bias 干的就是同一件事,只是它是动态加上去的。

# 建议的定位/修复步骤

```
r.VT.Residency.Show 1      # 每个池的 residency/bias 曲线图
r.VT.Residency.Notify 1    # 屏幕警告,直接告诉你是哪个池超订
stat virtualtexturing
```

确认是哪个物理池后:
- **正确修法**:加大该池。`DefaultEngine.ini` 的 `[/Script/Engine.VirtualTexturePoolConfig]` 里按 format 配 `SizeInMegabyte`,或全局 `r.VT.PoolSizeScale`
- 也可以对该池单独关掉 residency bias(pool config 里 `bEnableResidencyMipMapBias=false`),或全局 `r.VT.Residency.EnableMipMapBias 0` —— 代价是池不够时改为换页抖动(thrashing)而不是变糊
- 顺带一提:你们这棵树里已有一处相关本地修复([TexturePagePool.cpp:360](Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/VT/TexturePagePool.cpp#L360) `[Haro++]`,把 locked 页从可见比率里剔除,避免 bias 永不衰减)。既然装了这个修复还在爬 bias,说明那个池是**真超订**——相机不动时所需页集合稳定但已 >95% 池容量,先用上面的命令确认是哪个池、差多少。

events.content:
两张图对得上,但先纠正一个统计口径:你说的"更新数量"(`Num page update`)其实不是"RVT 重新渲染的 tile 数"。真正渲染 tile 的是 `RVT Draw Pages`(7 → 8,几乎没变,因为被预算钉死了)。暴涨的是**需求侧(feedback 请求)**,而这正是模糊的上游原因。逐条对一下:

| 计数器 | Nanite 关 (#3) | Nanite 开 (#4) | 含义(代码位置) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Num page visible | 893 | **2575 (峰值 5413)** | feedback 解析出的每帧唯一请求页数 [VirtualTextureSystem.cpp:1879](Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/VT/VirtualTextureSystem.cpp#L1879) |
| Num page visible resident | 462 (52%) | **124 (5%)** | 请求页中已在物理池里的 |
| Num page visible not resident | 431 | **2450** | 缺页数 |
| Num page prefetch | 13 | **1519** | 缺页太多触发的中间级预取 [VirtualTextureSystem.cpp:1766](Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/VT/VirtualTextureSystem.cpp#L1766) |
| Num stacks requested | 32(钉死) | 29(钉死) | 排序后被 clamp 到编辑器预算 `r.VT.MaxUploadsPerFrameInEditor=32` [VirtualTextureSystem.cpp:2086](Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/VT/VirtualTextureSystem.cpp#L2086) |
| **Num page allocation fails** | **31.8** | **29.3** | 尝试生产的每个 tile 都因**池里无可分配页**失败 [VirtualTextureSystem.cpp:2230](Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/VT/VirtualTextureSystem.cpp#L2230) |
| **Num stacks produced** | **0.17** | **0.03** | 实际生产出来的 tile ≈ **0** |

# 因果链

`AnyFreeAvailable()` 要求堆顶页至少 60 帧(`r.VT.PageFreeThreshold`)没被 GPU 用过才可淘汰([TexturePagePool.cpp:202](Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/VT/TexturePagePool.cpp#L202))。当工作集 ≥ 池容量时,池内每一页每帧都被 touch → 永远没有可淘汰页 → **分配全失败、产出为 0** → 缺的页永远补不上,同时 residency 比率恒在 UpperBound 之上 → `ResidencyMipMapBias` 以 0.2/帧爬到 +4 → 渐进模糊。bias 爬升本质上是系统故意的泄压阀:每 +1 级需求页数除以 4,直到工作集塞得进池子,然后就稳定在"模糊但不抖动"的状态。

所以回答你的问题:**是**——Nanite 开启后请求集 ~3 倍(峰值 5400 页)把池子的超订推到极端(resident 从 52% 掉到 5%),residency bias 拉满,就是你看到的模糊。但注意 #3 图里 allocation fails 也是打满的(31.8/帧、produced 0.17)——**Nanite 关的时候池子就已经饱和了**,这解释了你最初"相机不动也逐渐糊"的现象;Nanite 只是把缺口放大了 6 倍,不是唯一根因。

# 为什么 Nanite 会放大需求

最可能的机制:Nanite 材质走 compute shading 路径,UV 导数是**解析导数**(逐像素精确),而传统光栅走 2×2 quad 的硬件导数(天然偏保守/偏糊)。同一画面下解析导数普遍选到更精细的 mip,vLevel 低 1 级 = 同屏页数 ×4,和你 3~6 倍的涨幅量级吻合。地形这种大面积掠射角表面对导数差异最敏感。可以这样验证:`r.VT.Verbose 1` 看丢弃的请求,或对同机位分别抓 `r.VT.Dump` 比较两种路径请求的 vLevel 分布。

# 怎么处理

关键认知:**瓶颈不在上传预算,在池分配**。调大 `r.VT.MaxUploadsPerFrame`/`MaxTilesProducedPerFrame` 没用,fails 是池满导致的。

1. 先定量:`r.VT.ListPhysicalPools` 和 `r.VT.DumpPoolUsage` 看是哪个 format 组的池、缺多少(需求峰值 5400 页 vs 池容量一目了然)
2. **扩池**:`[/Script/Engine.VirtualTexturePoolConfig]` 里按 format 加 `SizeInMegabyte`,快速验证可先 `r.VT.PoolSizeScale 2`
3. **压需求**:`r.VT.RVT.TileCountBias.Group{0..2}` 给负值降 RVT 有效分辨率,针对 Nanite 带来的过细 mip 请求这是对症的
4. 快速验证因果(非修复):`r.VT.Residency.EnableMipMapBias 0`,画面应立即恢复清晰,代价是池 thrashing(每帧反复生产/淘汰,`RenderPage` 开销上涨)

另外你们本地那个 `[Haro]` 修复(locked 页不计入 residency 比率)在这个场景下方向是对的,但这里是真超订——unlocked 部分的工作集本身就 ≥ 池容量,所以 bias 依然爬,得靠 2/3 解决。
